messages.author: 6676e05bea601bee
messages.subject: INLA crash
parts:
Hello,

I am testing INLA for GP classification using a squared exponential kernel. As this covariance structure is not specified in the package, I am using the generic0 model, with the covariance matrix pre-computed. My code is as follows:

data=data.frame(y=c(y, rep(NA,n_new)),ind=1:N)
hyper2=list(theta=list(prior="loggamma",param=c(exp(-2*l_sqrtsigma),1)))
formula=y~-1+f(ind,model="generic0",Cmatrix=C,hyper=hyper2)
post=inla(formula,data=data, family="binomial",Ntrials=rep(1,N),control.family=list(link="probit"),control.predictor = list(link = 1),control.inla=list(strategy="laplace"),verbose=TRUE)

 I get the following error message:

Error in inla.inlaprogram.has.crashed() :
  The inla-program exited with an error. Unless you interupted it yourself, please rerun with verbose=TRUE and check the output carefully.
  If this does help; please contact the developers at <he...@r-inla.org>.

Attached is full output after running with inla(...,verbose=TRUE).

Any help would be great!
Thanks,
Sara
